items.title: Serbia after Vucic: The winners are losing patience
items.titleOrig: Serbia after Vucic: The winners are losing patience
items.desc: After the Student List's election victory, Aleksandar Vucic's power apparatus is disintegrating. People want justice as soon as possible. But the losers still hold sway in the judiciary and administration.

items.title: More than 290 arrested in France as some weekend protests turn violent
items.titleOrig: More than 290 arrested in France as some weekend protests turn violent
items.desc: Protests continue across France as 320,000 people take to the streets over rising living costs and poor school conditions for a third consecutive weekend, with clashes reported in several cities.

items.title: Germany's Gen Z protests disrupted by violence on Saturday
items.titleOrig: Germany's Gen Z protests disrupted by violence on Saturday
items.desc: Nationwide protests led by young people were largely peaceful throughout the day, but reports about looting and rioting in the evening, especially in Frankfurt, overshadowed the spirit of the demonstrations.

items.title: Ukraine news: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Kyiv-controlled territory
items.titleOrig: Ukraine news: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Kyiv-controlled territory
items.desc: After Melania Trump reportedly brokered a localized truce, residents of Ukraine's Oleshky managed to leave the occupied city. Meanwhile, Kyiv claimed a hit on a Russian rocket fuel plant. DW has more.

items.title: Germany news: Merkel calls for first female president
items.titleOrig: Germany news: Merkel calls for first female president
items.desc: Former Chancellor Angela Merkel says it's time to consider a woman as Germany's next president. Meanwhile, Berlin's Left Party is deciding whether to enter coalition talks. DW has more.

items.title: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?
items.titleOrig: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?
items.desc: A wave of shootings and extortion threats has rattled India's film industry. This time, those claiming responsibility are very different from the Mumbai underworld that had Bollywood in its grip back in the 1990s.

items.title: Embarrassing name? How we live with names we don't like
items.titleOrig: Embarrassing name? How we live with names we don't like
items.desc: What happens when your name evokes laughter or ridicule? Research points to negative life outcomes, but some people learn to embrace unfortunate names.

items.titleOrig: India news: Amit Shah challenges Rahul Gandhi to debate vote theft in parliament
items.desc: Home Minister Amit Shah has challenged Rahul Gandhi to debate electoral irregularity allegations in parliament, ahead of a major opposition rally against the election chief in Delhi.

items.title: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara to expire amid US, Russia vetoes
items.titleOrig: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara to expire amid US, Russia vetoes
items.desc: The mandate of the UN peacekeeping force in Western Sahara will expire on October 31. The UN Security Council could not agree on a resolution to extend the mission.

items.title: European diplomats shun Russia at G20 gathering in the US
items.titleOrig: European diplomats shun Russia at G20 gathering in the US
items.desc: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov declined to comment on Russia's participation in the G20 summit in December, telling DW that Volodymyr Zelenskyy should travel to Russia if he wanted talks with Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Poland: Protesters, police clash amid top court standoff
items.titleOrig: Poland: Protesters, police clash amid top court standoff
items.desc: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk defended the suspension of top court President Bogdan Swieczkowski as a move to "restore the rule of law."

items.title: Canadian PM Mark Carney discusses talks with the EU, overdependence on the US and how to deal with Donald Trump in a DW interview.
items.titleOrig: Canadian PM Mark Carney discusses talks with the EU, overdependence on the US and how to deal with Donald Trump in a DW interview.
items.desc: Prime Minister Mark Carney tells DW that Canada is seeking closer EU ties to "diversify and deepen" partnerships beyond the Americas. Despite German pushback, he said he favors the all-new term "associate membership."

items.title: Ukraine: Oleshky residents evacuate war-ravaged city
items.titleOrig: Ukraine: Oleshky residents evacuate war-ravaged city
items.desc: Under the local ceasefire, an aid convoy of 25 buses arrived with humanitarian aid and as transport for fleeing Oleshky residents. The Ukrainian city has been occupied by Russia since 2022 and faces food shortages.

items.title: Smuggling, power, profit: Irregular migration out of eastern Libya
items.titleOrig: Smuggling, power, profit: Irregular migration out of eastern Libya
items.desc: There is currently more irregular migration between eastern Libya and Crete, Greece. It's raising questions as to what connects people smugglers with powerful militias in eastern Libya and then in turn, Europeans.

items.title: Tennessee woman Christa Pike describes pain after failed execution
items.titleOrig: Tennessee woman Christa Pike describes pain after failed execution
items.desc: Christa Pike says she remains in constant pain a month after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee. Her lawyers want her death sentence reduced to life, while the state governor has ordered an investigation.

items.title: What the rift within the Tsikhanouski family means for the Belarusian opposition in exile
items.titleOrig: What the rift within the Tsikhanouski family means for the Belarusian opposition in exile
items.desc: Siarhei Tsikhanouski criticizes the work of his wife, Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya, and her office. He also questions her legitimacy. What are the implications for Belarusian political forces in exile?

items.title: US midterms: Pope Leo XIV casts vote by mail
items.titleOrig: US midterms: Pope Leo XIV casts vote by mail
items.desc: As a US citizen, Pope Leo XIV is eligible to vote in US elections and has made use of that right with a postal ballot ahead of Tuesday's midterms. The pontiff, a Chicago native, did not reveal who he voted for.

items.title: Binance crypto exchange suspends trades over North Korea-linked hack
items.titleOrig: Binance crypto exchange suspends trades over North Korea-linked hack
items.desc: Crypto platform Binance has suspended trading following a suspected hack now linked to North Korea. The disruption has left users unable to trade on the cryptocurrency platform while the suspected breach is investigated.

items.titleOrig: Germany news: Merz hopes for Korean reunification at DMZ
items.desc: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed hope for Korean reunification during a visit to the heavily fortified border. Meanwhile, President Steinmeier has held talks with China's Xi Jinping in Beijing.
